integrity: The analytic matrix identity, trace, determinant, phase classification, and asymptotic argument are independently displayed. The exact-arithmetic verifier checks finite rational instances and a sharp witness, not all real parameters. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact two-step frontier applies only to two independent equations in two dimensions, iid uniform singleton-row draws, a particular norm-dependent volume-ratio relaxation rule, and exact arithmetic. It does not imply uniform improvement, asymptotic superiority, larger-system extension, or finite-precision performance.
title: An exact two-step relaxation frontier for uniformly sampled Kaczmarz
